items.title: Run Nix packages in browsers
items.oneliner: Browser VM runs over 310,083 Nix package versions instantly, so you can test CLIs without installing anything.

items.title: Asahi Linux supports M3 Macs
items.oneliner: Official M3 support lets you boot Linux on Apple Silicon today, with webcam, microphones, USB, and install steps documented.

items.title: Plain text file registry
items.oneliner: Assign permanent IDs to files and keep searchable JSONL metadata even after renames or moves.

items.title: Open source iOS habit tracker
items.oneliner: Privacy-first Swift app tracks habits locally with non-binary scoring, iCloud sync, and no accounts or subscriptions.

items.title: Low boilerplate Zig CLI parsing
items.oneliner: Lightweight Zig parser cuts command line boilerplate while adding argument validation for small tools and CLIs.

items.title: Go SIMD speeds code search
items.oneliner: Deep dive shows how Go SIMD and AVX512 removed cgo from Debian Code Search and accelerated TurboPFor decoding.

items.title: Visual guide to Rust vtables
items.oneliner: Hands-on Rust tutorial visualizes dyn Trait memory layout so you can understand dispatch costs instead of guessing.

items.oneliner: Step-by-step NetBSD 11 walkthrough shows manual partitioning, setup, and bootstrapping on older hardware without sysinst.

items.title: Build Brainfuck DSL in Forth
items.oneliner: Code-heavy metaprogramming tutorial shows how to generate a Brainfuck DSL in Forth from first principles.

items.title: Free OCaml programming textbook
